records.title: C-Mamba: Channel Correlation Enhanced State Space Models for Multivariate Time Series Forecasting
records.reason: CMamba adapts Mamba with channel mixing for multivariate forecasting accuracy; its abstract does not report efficiency gains or inference-cost measurements, leaving the serving-efficiency connection uncertain.

records.title: SE(3)-Hyena Operator for Scalable Equivariant Learning
records.reason: SE(3)-Hyena replaces quadratic equivariant attention with sub-quadratic long convolution; the abstract reports 3.5x faster processing and 175x longer context at the same memory budget, a transferable sequence-system efficiency result.

records.title: DermaMamba: A Dual-Branch Vision Mamba Architecture with Linear Complexity for Efficient Skin Lesion Classification
records.reason: The official MDPI abstract describes DermaMamba’s CNN/VMamba fusion with linear-complexity global modeling and reports 2.3x inference speedup plus 40% lower memory than the stated baseline; the SSM efficiency mechanism is transferable beyond its medical-imaging task.

records.title: A Vision Toward Energy-Efficient Domain-Specific Artificial Intelligence Models and Agents
records.reason: The arXiv abstract is a vision for compact domain-specific AI and energy-efficient agents, including a target of large system-level efficiency gains, but it offers goals and hardware direction rather than a concrete evaluated inference method.

records.title: Scalable Artificial Intelligence for Science: Perspectives, Methods and Exemplars
records.reason: The arXiv abstract is a perspective on scaling scientific AI on HPC/cloud and lists scientific use cases; it does not present a concrete inference-efficiency method.

records.title: Integrated electro-optic attention nonlinearities for transformers
records.reason: The paper implements electro-optic alternatives to digital Softmax/Sigmoid, identifies nonlinearities as a disproportionate Transformer inference-latency bottleneck, and evaluates the hardware units in ViTs and LLMs.

records.title: BOLT: Fewer Tokens but More Performance Retention for Efficient Vision-Language Models Inference
records.reason: The candidate DOI and title are retained, but the ACM primary URL `https://dl.acm.org/doi/10.1145/3746027.3755305` returned `(403) Forbidden`; no primary abstract was retrievable.

records.title: Local Information Matters: Inference Acceleration For Grounded Conversation Generation Models Through Adaptive Local-Aware Token Pruning
records.reason: ALTP prunes visual tokens in grounded-conversation LLaVA models while retaining object-local detail; the abstract reports 90% fewer visual tokens with maintained or improved grounding metrics, directly targeting multimodal inference cost.

records.title: Artifacts and Attention Sinks: Structured Approximations for Efficient Vision Transformers
records.reason: Fast Nyström Attention approximates ViT self-attention in linear time and space using structured attention-sink/artifact patterns and reports reduced computational overhead across vision tasks.

records.title: Attention in Diffusion Model: A Survey
records.reason: The arXiv abstract surveys attention operations and modifications in diffusion models but reports no new evaluated inference-efficiency mechanism; possible transfer from attention methods remains indirect.

records.title: video-SALMONN S: Streaming Audio-Visual LLMs Beyond Length Limits via Memory
records.reason: video-SALMONN S uses test-time training as streaming memory and processes over three-hour videos at 1 FPS/360p while outperforming non-streaming models under the same memory budget, a concrete long-context multimodal-serving design.

records.title: Progressive NAS for Efficient Structural Pruning of Pretrained Language Models
records.reason: The supplied DOI/title identify a language-model structural-pruning/NAS paper, but the primary DOI URL `https://doi.org/10.1109/APCCAS67402.2025.11377091` returned `URL https://doi.org/10.1109/APCCAS67402.2025.11377091 is not accessible via this tool` (repeat open: `Internal Error ()`); its publisher abstract could not be retrieved.

records.title: Pico: A Modular Framework for Hypothesis-Driven Small Language Model Research
records.reason: Pico is a reproducible framework for hypothesis-driven small-language-model architecture and training experiments; the arXiv abstract does not present inference or deployment efficiency methods.

records.title: Tango: Taming Visual Signals for Efficient Video Large Language Models
records.reason: Tango improves visual-token selection and clustering in Video LLMs; its abstract reports retaining 98.9% of baseline performance with 10% of video tokens and 1.88x inference speedup.

records.title: Optimization over Trained (and Sparse) Neural Networks: A Surrogate within a Surrogate
records.reason: The paper prunes neural networks to make constraint-learning optimization models more tractable and explicitly notes that the pruned network may have worse inference; its objective is optimization-model solvability, not efficient inference.

records.title: TOAST: Transformer Optimization using Adaptive and Simple Transformations
records.reason: TOAST replaces redundant pretrained Transformer blocks with lightweight closed-form mappings without retraining and reports reduced parameters and computation while preserving or improving task performance.

records.title: RCT: Resource Constrained Training for Edge AI
records.reason: RCT reduces model memory and energy during edge training by retaining quantized parameters and adjusting bitwidths; its abstract focuses on training resource constraints, not inference/serving efficiency.

records.title: MetaBERT: Collaborative Meta-Learning for Accelerating BERT Inference
records.reason: The supplied DOI/title are retained, but the IEEE Xplore primary page `https://ieeexplore.ieee.org/document/10152853` displayed JavaScript-disabled/robot-verification content; no publisher abstract was retrievable.

records.title: Strategic Doctrine Language Models (sdLM): A Comprehensive Framework for Automated Military Planning and Doctrinal Analysis
records.reason: The title is an automated military-planning and doctrinal-analysis application of language models, with no stated model-inference or serving-efficiency contribution.

records.title: Onboard Hyperspectral Super-Resolution with Deep Pushbroom Neural Network
records.reason: The title is hyperspectral-image super-resolution, an independent imaging application without an indicated LLM systems or transferable inference-efficiency mechanism.
